title: Theater review: Atasha Muhlach rises to the challenge in ‘Bongga Ka, ’Day!’
summary: Atasha Muhlach faced considerable expectations in the title role of Annie Batungbakal but delivers an exuberant and charming performance in Newport World Resorts’ latest jukebox musical.
